diagram_previews.alt: Rhombus with vertices A(4,0), B(0,2), C(-4,0), D(0,-2) and dashed diagonals meeting at O; the shaded inscribed square PQRS has vertices (4/3, 4/3), (-4/3, 4/3), (-4/3, -4/3), (4/3, -4/3), one on each side of the rhombus.

difficulty_rationale: The computation is short once the square is placed symmetrically; justifying that the inscribed square must be centred at the centre of the rhombus takes an extra idea.
